subject: POC success criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@atlaspayments.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC recap + draft success criteria (next steps)

Hi Priya / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation and clear focus areas. Per our call, here is a short recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC kicked off next week: 

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Primary use: customer support automation (realtime response + summarization of agent interactions)
- Expected peak workload: ~12k messages/day, 90th percentile concurrency ~45 requests/min
- Security: Atlas requires VPC/private deployment or dedicated tenancy; SOC 2 + audit logs required

Draft success criteria / KPIs (proposal)
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end < 800 ms for short queries (<128 tokens)
- Throughput: sustain 40 reqs/min with SLAs on queue depth; burst to 100 reqs/min
- Quality: ASR of summarization / NPS proxy — human evaluation quality >= 4/5 on sampled prompts
- Cost: target variable inference cost <= $0.004 per 1k tokens (goal; allow +/-20%)

Next steps
1) Redwood to share a 2-week POC plan + light test harness (what we'll measure) — owner: me (Jordan). Attached: redwood-poc-plan.pdf
2) Atlas to confirm success criteria and provide sample prompts + representative data subset — owner: Priya
3) Technical kickoff to scope private deployment options and sign SOW draft — propose Feb 18 for kickoff call

Please reply with any edits to the criteria above. If that looks good, Priya — can you share the sample dataset and the person on your side who will own acceptance?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (see attached POC plan: timeline, measurements, owners)

From: Priya Shah <priya@atlaspayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@atlaspayments.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC recap + draft success criteria (next steps)

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications and adjustments from our side: 

- Latency: 95th percentile <= 600 ms would be ideal for our agent workflow, but we understand there are tradeoffs with batch size; aim for <=800 ms to start, iterate down during POC.
- Throughput: the 40 reqs/min baseline is fine; we do want a verified burst capacity to 120 reqs/min for flash events.
- Quality: our acceptance will include automated heuristics + 150 human-eval samples (we'll share). Target: at least 85% of summaries rated "actionable" by our agents.
- Cost: we'll track $/1000 tokens for inference. Please include a cost report in the test harness.

Owner: I'll own acceptance on Atlas side (Priya Shah). Ben will own infra coordination. We'll upload a 2% sanitized sample of transcripts to the Drive link you shared by EOD Fri (Feb 12).

Confirming Feb 18 for kickoff works for us — suggest 10:00 AM PT. Also please share the SOW draft ahead of the call.

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of CX Technology | Atlas Payments
priya@atlaspayments.com

Thanks — jumping in with technical details we'll use to validate the KPIs. A few notes and a small ask from Atlas: 

Validation approach
- Latency measurement: instrument end-to-end (client -> Redwood -> model -> response). We'll report p50/p90/p95 and tail latencies. For fairness, we'll run tests with representative request sizes: short (<128 tokens), medium (128-512), long (>512).
- Throughput: run sustained load tests to verify steady-state and burst behavior. We'll capture queue depth, batch sizes, and GPU utilization.
- Cost: we'll calculate cost/token using actual token counts per request and Redwood's per-token price for the model used; include breakdown per model variant.
- Quality: Marissa's team will run the 150 human evals and provide a confusion matrix and examples of failure modes.

Ask from Atlas
- Need a sample of 500 anonymized transcripts (or 2% if larger) to seed the test harness. Prefer CSV with columns: id, prompt, expected_summary, metadata.

I've added a tab in the attached test harness with the exact metrics we will populate (redwood-poc-test-harness.xlsx). If Priya can share the upload by Fri we can finish the test accounts before the kickoff.

I'll prepare an initial baseline report template to share during the Feb 18 kickoff.

-Marissa
